segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the cream calmed her skin and strengthened her barrier without irritation, though she notes fragrance did not bother her specifically.
segments.normal: A 47-year-old reviewer with fair/normal skin describes the product as unscented, very nourishing, and good under makeup.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions her age (47) reports the cream is very nourishing and works well under makeup.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, glowy, and good under makeup; one reviewer felt it did not moisturize deeply enough and found it more gel-like than expected.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports it strengthened her skin barrier and kept her skin calm.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-tendency skin report the cream did not cause new breakouts and is non-comedogenic.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically discusses spots or hyperpigmentation.

aspects.libelle: Too rich for summer daytime use

reserve: With only 8 short reviews and little detail on skin type or specific concerns beyond hydration, conclusions for concerns like aging, redness, spots, and oiliness cannot be drawn.
